limits: Elo-Odds was a predeclared control, not one of the two selectable candidates; these new comparisons are post hoc.
Selection dates and all source labels were already historically exposed; no prospective or fresh holdout claim.
Only EPL season-start years 2022 and 2023 are scored here; no additional 7-day sensitivity or 2024–2025 country transfer is authorized by the failed family gate.
Archived prior-market receipt timestamps remain unknown. Input admission uses next local midnight plus one extra local calendar day (D+2), strictly before original issuance.
The same two unsupported fixtures retain the exact incumbent vector in all candidate/control forecasts.
No causal attribution or production/predictive gain is established by a favorable post hoc comparator diagnostic.
